text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before training began, I was explaining 
today's menu to Sweep Tosho, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...No way. Running on dirt gets sand 
inside my shoes, so I don't want to do 
it."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And I don't wanna do hill training either. 
It's exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho seems unenthusiastic. If so, 
to catch her interest, I should..."
choice_data_list:
Let's squeeze in some magical training in 
between.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm not in the mood to move today! I'm 
watching TV right here! I'm not budging 
from this spot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She's not biting on things that would 
usually interest her. Race fatigue might 
still be lingering. We may need to review 
the schedule."
